prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for every implant case, but **Dr. David McFadden at The Dental Implant Center** is a strong Dallas option to investigate—particularly for complex restorations. The practice lists him as board-certified in prosthodontics and oral implantology, and says it focuses on implant treatment. It’s at **5120 W. Lovers Lane, Dallas**; **(214) 956-9100**. [Practice details](https://www.dentalimplantcenter.com/our-practice/)

For a second opinion, you could also consult a periodontist, such as **Park Cities Periodontics & Implant Dentistry**, which focuses on implant placement and gum and bone issues. [Practice details](https://parkcitiesperio.com/)

Before choosing, ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, what the full treatment plan and total cost are, and what alternatives or risks apply to your case. Confirm credentials and get an independent second opinion—especially for full-arch treatment or bone grafting.
